user.title: Connect to N.I.N.A.
user.description: Enter the details for your N.I.N.A. instance running the Advanced API plugin (port 1888 by default). The instance name prefixes every device and entity id, so give each rig a distinct name if you run more than one.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to N.I.N.A. – check host/port and ensure the Advanced API plugin is running.
error.unknown: Unexpected error – check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This N.I.N.A. instance is already configured.

camera_cool.name: Cool Camera
camera_cool.description: Start cooling the camera sensor to a target temperature.

temperature.name: Target Temperature
temperature.description: Target sensor temperature in degrees Celsius.

minutes.name: Ramp Time
minutes.description: Minutes over which to ramp to the target temperature. Use -1 for the duration configured in the active N.I.N.A. profile.

cancel.name: Cancel
cancel.description: Cancel a cooling run that is already in progress.

camera_warm.name: Warm Camera
camera_warm.description: Gradually warm the camera sensor back to ambient temperature.

minutes.name: Ramp Time
minutes.description: Minutes over which to ramp back to ambient. -1 uses the profile default.

cancel.name: Cancel
cancel.description: Cancel a warming run that is already in progress.

camera_capture.name: Capture Image
camera_capture.description: Take a single camera exposure. Binning and filter are not parameters of this endpoint — set them first with Set Binning and Change Filter.

duration.name: Exposure
duration.description: Exposure duration in seconds. Omit to use the plate-solve exposure time.

gain.name: Gain
gain.description: Gain override for this exposure. Omit to use the camera default.

save.name: Save to Disk
save.description: Save the captured image. Required when capturing rather than previewing.

wait_for_result.name: Wait for Result
wait_for_result.description: Block until the capture finishes instead of returning immediately.

image_type.name: Image Type
image_type.description: Frame type recorded for this exposure.

target_name.name: Target Name
target_name.description: Target name recorded with the frame. Useful for livestacking.

camera_abort_capture.name: Abort Capture
camera_abort_capture.description: Abort the current camera exposure immediately.

camera_set_binning.name: Set Binning
camera_set_binning.description: Set the camera binning mode. Must be a mode the camera reports, e.g. 1x1 or 2x2.

camera_set_dew_heater.name: Set Dew Heater
camera_set_dew_heater.description: Turn the camera's dew heater on or off.

mount_slew.name: Slew Mount
mount_slew.description: Slew the telescope mount to the given coordinates.

ra.name: Right Ascension
ra.description: Target RA in decimal DEGREES (0–360). Multiply RA in hours by 15.

dec.name: Declination
dec.description: Target Dec in decimal degrees (−90 to +90).

center.name: Center
center.description: Plate solve and center on the target after slewing.

rotate.name: Center and Rotate
rotate.description: Center and rotate to the given rotation angle.

rotation_angle.name: Rotation Angle
rotation_angle.description: Rotation angle in degrees. Requires Center and Rotate.

mount_sync.name: Sync Mount
mount_sync.description: Sync the mount's reported position to the given coordinates.

mount_park.name: Park Mount
mount_park.description: Send the telescope mount to its park position.

mount_meridian_flip.name: Meridian Flip
mount_meridian_flip.description: Perform a meridian flip if one is needed. This never forces a flip.

mode.name: Tracking Mode
mode.description: Tracking rate to use. Choose Stopped to disable tracking.

focuser_move.name: Move Focuser
focuser_move.description: Move the focuser to an absolute step position.

focuser_auto_focus.name: Auto Focus
focuser_auto_focus.description: Trigger an autofocus routine using the configured method.

cancel.name: Cancel
cancel.description: Cancel an autofocus run that is already in progress.

filterwheel_change_filter.name: Change Filter
filterwheel_change_filter.description: Rotate the filter wheel to the filter with the given Id.

filter_id.name: Filter Id
filter_id.description: The filter's Id as reported by the wheel — see the available_filters attribute on the Current Filter sensor. This is not a list position.

calibrate.name: Force Calibration
calibrate.description: Force a new calibration run before guiding begins.

rotator_move.name: Move Rotator
rotator_move.description: Move the rotator to a position in degrees.

mechanical.name: Mechanical
mechanical.description: Treat the position as a mechanical angle rather than a sky angle.

dome_slew.name: Slew Dome
dome_slew.description: Slew the dome to an azimuth.

dome_set_follow.name: Set Dome Follow
dome_set_follow.description: Start or stop the dome following the telescope.

switch_set_value.name: Set Switch Value
switch_set_value.description: Set a value on the connected switch device.

index.name: Switch Index
index.description: Index of the switch to set.

value.name: Value
value.description: Value to set, within the switch's own minimum and maximum.

sequence_start.name: Start Sequence
sequence_start.description: Start the currently loaded imaging sequence.

skip_validation.name: Skip Validation
skip_validation.description: Start without running N.I.N.A.'s pre-flight validation.

sequence_skip.name: Skip Sequence Items
sequence_skip.description: Skip ahead in the running sequence.

type.name: Skip Type
type.description: CurrentItems skips the running instructions, ToImaging jumps to the imaging container, ToEnd jumps to the end of the sequence.

sequence_reset.name: Reset Sequence
sequence_reset.description: Reset the loaded sequence's progress back to the start.

sequence_load.name: Load Sequence
sequence_load.description: Load a sequence by name from N.I.N.A.'s configured sequence folder. Names come from the sequence/list-available endpoint — this is a name, not a path.

sequence_name.name: Sequence Name
sequence_name.description: Name of the sequence to load.

flats_trained_flat.name: Take Trained Flats
flats_trained_flat.description: Run the flat wizard using the filter's trained flat settings.

count.name: Count
count.description: Number of flat frames to take.

filter_id.name: Filter Id
filter_id.description: Filter to use. Omit for the current filter.

keep_closed.name: Keep Cover Closed
keep_closed.description: Leave the flat panel cover closed after the run.

flats_auto_exposure.name: Take Auto-Exposure Flats
flats_auto_exposure.description: Run the flat wizard at a fixed panel brightness, letting N.I.N.A. pick the exposure time that reaches the target histogram mean.

brightness.name: Panel Brightness
brightness.description: Fixed flat panel brightness to hold during the run.

flats_auto_brightness.name: Take Auto-Brightness Flats
flats_auto_brightness.description: Run the flat wizard at a fixed exposure time, letting N.I.N.A. pick the flat panel brightness that reaches the target histogram mean.

exposure_time.name: Exposure Time
exposure_time.description: Fixed exposure time to hold during the run.

flats_skyflat.name: Take Sky Flats
flats_skyflat.description: Run the flat wizard against the twilight sky.

flats_stop.name: Stop Flat Wizard
flats_stop.description: Stop the running flat wizard process.

application_switch_tab.name: Switch Tab
application_switch_tab.description: Switch the active tab in the N.I.N.A. user interface.
